set.body: Implement the remaining stable neuroarchive quant semantics in Scala 3: add QuantMethod.Sd, compute mean-centered scale from 3*sample-sd for global and voxel scopes, preserve allow_clip hard clipping behavior, expose clipping counts/percentage in typed archive metadata or reports, and cover reconstruction/HDF5 roundtrips. Keep N-bit HDF5 filters separate from this pure transform bead.
